t.63449-41-2.agn: The harmonised classification is for the C8-18 alkyl mixture (index no 612-140-00-5); the C12-16 mixture common in commercial products (CAS 68424-85-1) belongs to the same group of substances. The pure substance is corrosive.
t.63449-41-2.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 612-140-00-5 (CLP00): Acute Tox. 4 (Dermal)*, Acute Tox. 4 (Oral)*, Skin Corr. 1B, Aquatic Acute 1.
t.63449-41-2.reg.det: Must be listed on the detergent label as a disinfectant, whatever its concentration.
t.63449-41-2.summary: A cationic disinfectant and preservative from the quaternary ammonium group.
t.63449-41-2.what: Kills bacteria and fungi; leaves a thin film on the surface.
t.tem.h.H312: H312 Harmful in contact with skin.
